description: This file contains the Sale model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, responsible for generating various sales reports such as total sales, orders by country, day, week, month, year, and detailed order data. It interacts with the database to retrieve and aggregate sales-related data based on different filters and groupings.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: A model class in the Opencart admin extension, dealing with sales data reporting, including methods to retrieve sales totals, orders, taxes, shipping, and other sales-related metrics.

methods.name: getTotalSales
methods.description: Calculates the total sales amount, optionally filtered by a specific date.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: An array of filters applied to the query, e.g., 'filter_date_added'.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCountry
methods.description: Retrieves the count and total amount of orders grouped by payment country.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByDay
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of orders for each hour of the current day, based on order status and date filters.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByWeek
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of orders grouped by day of the week for the current week, based on order status and date filters.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByMonth
methods.description: Provides total order counts for each day of the current month.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByYear
methods.description: Provides total order counts for each month of the current year.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches detailed order data with aggregate info, with optional filters for status and date range, and grouping options such as day, week, month, or year.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total count of distinct order dates, grouped by the specified grouping (day, week, month, year).

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Retrieves tax-related order totals, grouped by day, week, month, or year, with optional status and date filters.

methods.name: getTotalTaxes
methods.description: Counts distinct date entries for taxes, grouped by the specified period.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Retrieves shipping totals and counts, filtered similarly to other report methods.

methods.name: getTotalShipping
methods.description: Counts shipping records, grouped by the selected period.
